evidence.quote: Grafting moves from late March, as the 1 October call set it, to the second half of February.

observations.why: Explicitly ratifies a operational schedule change overriding the prior call.

evidence.quote: The rootstock is still dormant in February, and last year's February trial row took at twice the rate of the March grafts.

observations.why: Unhedged empirical assertion providing the rationale for the schedule shift.
